answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in violet, expire in hollow, and falcon lists each expiry. Anyone running 60 aliases as a result needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4201 identities would post 2732 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
